1903 Pocitos act - PLATE READ 21 Sep 202: *** EDUARDO *** ZALSAMENDI, father of the baptised child
1913 civil register - INDEX ONLY 10-11 O: *** EDUARDO *** ZALDUANDO POU, dead at Montevideo *** 22 August 1913 *** aged *** fifty-two ***, so born about *** 1861 ***, certificate 553
what it is worth: The forename alone proves nothing. It is the first of five.

1903 Pocitos act - PLATE READ 21 Sep 202: *** JUAN *** ZALSAMENDI, paternal grandfather on the act
1913 civil register - INDEX ONLY 10-11 O: *** JUAN *** ZALDUANDO, father of the deceased
what it is worth: Same forename in the same role.

1903 Pocitos act - PLATE READ 21 Sep 202: *** DOLORES POU *** de ZALSAMENDI - given in the Spanish married form, so POU is her own surname
1913 civil register - INDEX ONLY 10-11 O: *** DOLORES POU ***, plainly, mother of the deceased
what it is worth: *** THE STRONGEST LEG OF THE ARGUMENT. *** An index may mangle a Basque surname; it did not invent a Dolores Pou married to a Juan with a son Eduardo. And POU reappearing as the husband's own second surname is the ordinary Spanish form, which supports the match rather than weakening it.

1903 Pocitos act - PLATE READ 21 Sep 202: *** AMELIA LERENA ***, her parents given as "AVELINO y CELIDONIA B. de LERENA"
1913 civil register - INDEX ONLY 10-11 O: *** ANGELICA LERENA ***, daughter of *** AVELINO LERENA *** and *** CELEDONIA VILLADEMOROS ***
what it is worth: The PARENTS match exactly and the FORENAME does not. *** This is the one place the two records genuinely conflict ***, and it is left open.

1903 Pocitos act - PLATE READ 21 Sep 202: *** MARIA MARGARITA *** ZALSAMENDI Lerena, born *** 21 June 1903 ***, baptised at eight weeks
1913 civil register - INDEX ONLY 10-11 O: *** MARIA MARGARITA LUISA *** ZALDUONDO Lerena (index ark 1:1:6Y2Q-1WZB)
what it is worth: Taken to be one girl, who thereby gains a fourth given name - *** LUISA *** - and a brother.

what agrees: *** A son, new to this archive ***
1913 civil register - INDEX ONLY 10-11 O: *** EDUARDO AVELINO ***, born about *** 1901 at La Paz, in the department of CANELONES ***, married *** MARIA ESTER COSTA *** there on *** 20 December 1927 ***, certificate 30, her parents *** RAFAEL COSTA *** and *** LEONTINA SOASANI ***
what it is worth: *** THE ONLY GENUINELY NEW PEOPLE IN THE WHOLE EXERCISE *** - a son and his wife. He carries *** AVELINO ***, his mother's father's name, which is a small independent argument that his mother is a daughter of Avelino Eduardo Lerena Traibel.
